```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
augmented_data = read.csv("C:/Users/Zach/Downloads/covpot_data_aug_processed.csv")
augmented_data = augmented_data %>% select(-X) %>% rename(Conc. = concentration)

# Need to create a target vector column with Beta, Delta, WT, and Omicron
labels = str_match(augmented_data$Slide, "(?<=\\_)(.*?)(?=\\_)")[,1]
augmented_data = augmented_data %>% mutate(target_vector = labels,
                                           .after=Conc.)
# Need to log transform the data
augmented_data = augmented_data %>% mutate_at(vars(starts_with("cAb")), log10) %>% 
  select(-Slide)

augmented_data
augmented_data_dab18 = augmented_data[1:288,]
augmented_data_dab18

augmented_data_dab19 = augmented_data[289:576,]
augmented_data_dab19
```

```{r}
dab18_data = read.csv("dab18_data.csv")
dab18_data = dab18_data %>% select(-X)

dab19_data = read.csv("dab19_data.csv")
dab19_data = dab19_data %>% select(-X)

dab18_data
augmented_data_dab18_colnames = colnames(augmented_data_dab18)
dab18_data = dab18_data %>% select(augmented_data_dab18_colnames)
combined_dab18_data = bind_rows(augmented_data_dab18, dab18_data)
combined_dab18_data$target_vector = as.factor(combined_dab18_data$target_vector)

augmented_dab19_colnames = colnames(augmented_data_dab19)
dab19_data = dab19_data %>% select(augmented_dab19_colnames)
combined_dab19_data = bind_rows(augmented_data_dab19, dab19_data)
combined_dab19_data$target_vector = as.factor(combined_dab19_data$target_vector)

write.csv(combined_dab18_data, "augmented_dab18_data.csv")

write.csv(combined_dab19_data, "augmented_dab19_data.csv")

```
